rounds.response: Dear Councilmember Garcia and Staff, on behalf of the Local Retailers Coalition, I am writing to express our concern that the proposed single-use plastic bag fee will impose undue administrative burdens, checkout delays, and customer friction on independent shops. While we acknowledge that bag fees can successfully reduce plastic litter and generate municipal revenue—as documented in municipal evaluations like the 2012 Austin Resource Recovery report—research such as a 2018 University of Chicago study on grocery bag taxes demonstrates that these policies often shift disproportionate operational costs onto smaller retailers. To mitigate these commercial impacts without abandoning your environmental goals, we strongly recommend amending the draft to include a phased implementation timeline and an administrative credit allowing small businesses to retain a portion of the fee. We believe these targeted adjustments will protect local shops from unintended financial harm, and we welcome the opportunity to discuss them with your office.
